dry_probe.method: static schema/topology probe against frozen H7 hypothesis and productive input guards
dry_probe.purpose: prove case constructibility without querying ROBY

fail_closed_dimensions: required lineage is missing or mismatched
independence_guards: no H6 held-out/scoring artifacts may be read by corpus-construction code
no prior H7 held-out or calibration prompts may be copied or paraphrased
no ROBY output may be consulted while writing cases or expected classes
case IDs and scenario texts must be newly authored under V2I-H7 namespace
ground-truth details must live in a separate artifact from ROBY-facing prompts
next_gate: HCPDQ-v2 H7 Independent Corpus — Construction / Ground-Truth Freeze
positive_case_requirements: eligible for the certified planning re-entry surface
must require one existing planning invocation when later executed
must have independently specifiable requirement/source/snapshot lineage
must not imply action execution or authorization
